title: Verify: Manifest file validity and scene coverage unit tests
summary: Unit tests that manifest.json passes the validator and covers scene refs.
description: Test that the real manifest.json parses via parseManifest and every asset path exists and every bedroom.yaml asset ref has an id.
acceptance_criteria: Given manifest.json, when parseManifest runs, then ok is true
Given each entry, when path is resolved, then the file exists
Given bedroom.yaml asset refs, when matched, then each is a manifest id

steps.action: Read manifest.json with readFileSync and JSON.parse; assert parseManifest(...).ok is true; assert existsSync(join(publicDir, asset.path)) for each asset; load bedroom.yaml via the yaml package, collect object `asset` values and assert each is in the set of manifest ids; assert the character:boy entry has frames.frameCount 2 and animations.idle.
steps.command: cd game && npx vitest run tests/assetManifestFile.test.ts
